package course

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	domainservice "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/service"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const maximumResponseBytes = 1 << 20

type Client struct {
	BaseURL                string
	InternalToken          string
	DiagnosticCatalogToken string
	HTTPClient             *http.Client
}

func (client Client) EnsureCourse(
	ctx context.Context,
	course domain.GeneratedCourse,
	idempotencyKey string,
) (domain.EnsureCourseResult, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(client.InternalToken) == "" ||
		client.HTTPClient == nil || strings.TrimSpace(idempotencyKey) == "" {
		return domain.EnsureCourseResult{}, errors.New("course client is not configured")
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(idempotencyKey); err != nil {
		return domain.EnsureCourseResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	payload, err := json.Marshal(course)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.EnsureCourseResult{}, err
	}
	if len(payload) > domain.MaximumGeneratedCoursePayloadBytes {
		return domain.EnsureCourseResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	requestURL := strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/") + "/internal/generated-courses"
	request, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, requestURL, bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.EnsureCourseResult{}, err
	}
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	request.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", idempotencyKey)
	request.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	request.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	httpResponse, err := client.HTTPClient.Do(request)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.EnsureCourseResult{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = httpResponse.Body.Close() }()
	contents, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(httpResponse.Body, maximumResponseBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return domain.EnsureCourseResult{}, err
	}
	if len(contents) > maximumResponseBytes {
		return domain.EnsureCourseResult{}, errors.New("course response exceeds limit")
	}
	if httpResponse.StatusCode < 200 || httpResponse.StatusCode >= 300 {
		switch httpResponse.StatusCode {
		case http.StatusConflict:
			return domain.EnsureCourseResult{}, domain.ErrConflict
		case http.StatusBadRequest, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity:
			return domain.EnsureCourseResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
		default:
			return domain.EnsureCourseResult{}, fmt.Errorf("course returned status %d", httpResponse.StatusCode)
		}
	}
	var result domain.EnsureCourseResult
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(contents))
	if err := decoder.Decode(&result); err != nil {
		return domain.EnsureCourseResult{}, err
	}
	if _, err := uuid.Parse(result.CourseID); err != nil {
		return domain.EnsureCourseResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if len(result.Lessons) == 0 || len(result.Lessons) > 500 {
		return domain.EnsureCourseResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	for index := range result.Lessons {
		binding := &result.Lessons[index]
		if _, err := uuid.Parse(binding.LessonID); err != nil || binding.Order != index || len(binding.Targets) == 0 {
			return domain.EnsureCourseResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		if revision, err := uuid.Parse(binding.LessonRevisionID); err != nil || revision.String() != binding.LessonRevisionID {
			return domain.EnsureCourseResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		targets, err := domain.NormalizeTargetRefs(binding.Targets)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.EnsureCourseResult{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		binding.Targets = targets
	}
	return result, nil
}

var _ domainservice.CourseService = Client{}

// GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog uses the deliberately narrow Course projection.
// It rejects a catalogue which cannot be frozen safely by the diagnostic plan.
func (client Client) GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(ctx context.Context, courseID string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog, error) {
	parsedCourseID, parseErr := uuid.Parse(courseID)
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(client.DiagnosticCatalogToken) == "" || client.HTTPClient == nil || parseErr != nil || parsedCourseID.String() != courseID {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/")+"/internal/course/get-internal-diagnostic-assessments/"+courseID, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.DiagnosticCatalogToken)
	req.Header.Set("Accept", "application/json")
	safeClient := *client.HTTPClient
	safeClient.CheckRedirect = func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }
	resp, err := safeClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, maximumResponseBytes+1))
	if err != nil || len(body) > maximumResponseBytes {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	if resp.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
			return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		if resp.StatusCode >= 500 {
			return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrUpstreamUnavailable
		}
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	media, _, contentErr := mime.ParseMediaType(resp.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if contentErr != nil || media != "application/json" {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	var wire struct {
		Schema   string `json:"schema"`
		CourseID string `json:"course_id"`
		Revision string `json:"curric\u0075lum_revision"`
		Lessons  []struct {
			ID          string    `json:"id"`
			CourseID    string    `json:"course_id"`
			SectionID   string    `json:"section_id"`
			Title       string    `json:"title"`
			Description string    `json:"description"`
			Order       int       `json:"order"`
			Status      int       `json:"status"`
			UpdatedAt   time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
			Tasks       []struct {
				ID                string             `json:"id"`
				LessonID          string             `json:"lesson_id"`
				Title             string             `json:"title"`
				Description       string             `json:"description"`
				Type              int                `json:"type"`
				AssessmentPurpose string             `json:"assessment_purpose"`
				EvaluationMode    string             `json:"evaluation_mode"`
				Status            int                `json:"status"`
				Version           int64              `json:"version"`
				UpdatedAt         time.Time          `json:"updated_at"`
				Order             int                `json:"order"`
				LearningTargets   []domain.TargetRef `json:"learning_targets"`
			} `json:"tasks"`
		} `json:"lessons"`
	}
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(body))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := dec.Decode(&wire); err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	if err := dec.Decode(&struct{}{}); err != io.EOF {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	catalog := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{Schema: wire.Schema, CourseID: wire.CourseID, Revision: wire.Revision}
	for _, l := range wire.Lessons {
		if l.CourseID != wire.CourseID || l.Status != 1 {
			return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
		}
		for _, t := range l.Tasks {
			if t.LessonID != l.ID || t.Status != 1 || t.AssessmentPurpose != "diagnostic" || (t.Type != 11 && t.Type != 12 && t.Type != 13) || !validDiagnosticEvaluationMode(t.EvaluationMode) {
				return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
			}
			catalog.Assessments = append(catalog.Assessments, domain.DiagnosticAssessment{LessonID: l.ID, TaskID: t.ID, TaskVersion: t.Version, UpdatedAt: t.UpdatedAt, LessonOrder: l.Order, TaskOrder: t.Order, LearningTargets: t.LearningTargets})
		}
	}
	result, err := domain.NormalizeDiagnosticCatalog(catalog)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrUpstreamInvalid
	}
	return result, nil
}

func validDiagnosticEvaluationMode(value string) bool { return value == "AUTO" }

var _ domainservice.CourseService = Client{}
var _ domainservice.DiagnosticCourseCatalogService = Client{}
